# install-mcp

> One-command CLI that installs the Unison Memory MCP server into any AI client
> (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Windsurf, and more) and provisions a
> `usk_` API key automatically — no manual setup required.

**Agents: start with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)** — it covers how to install the
package, authenticate with a `usk_` key, and use the CLI from a script or
agent context, plus how to contribute to this repo.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): what it does, usage, env vars, auth flow, supported clients
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent-specific install guide and contributing section
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): development workflow, conventions, PR checklist
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting policy

## Usage

```bash
npx @unisonlabs/install-mcp                        # interactive
npx @unisonlabs/install-mcp --client claude-code   # specify client
npx @unisonlabs/install-mcp --client cursor --yes  # skip confirmation
UNISON_TOKEN=usk_... npx @unisonlabs/install-mcp   # bring your own token
```

## Examples

```bash
# Install for Claude Code with a known token, no prompts
UNISON_TOKEN=usk_live_... UNISON_API_URL=https://brain.unisonlabs.ai \
  npx @unisonlabs/install-mcp --client claude-code --skip-auth --yes

# Install project-scoped config for Cursor
npx @unisonlabs/install-mcp --client cursor --local

# Use a self-hosted brain
npx @unisonlabs/install-mcp --client codex --api-url https://brain.example.com
```
